name: Ligus 2.0.0
notes: Hive is now Ligus, short for ligustica. The CLI is ligus, settings are LIGUS_*, config is ligus.config.toml and workspace state lives in .ligus/; existing data (desktop data folder, .hive/, hive.config.toml, ~/.hive) moves over automatically on first use, and HIVE_* environment variables must be renamed. Features: repos from the phone with fork-aware pull requests opened upstream as drafts; whole-file proposal view so the phone renders Markdown changes; Kubernetes deployment design and a container image for the ligus binary.
